transcript.text: My laboratory review this morning classified the solvent as UN1993 flammable liquid, packing group II, rather than routine recyclable solvent. This means the 18 totes must be transferred into 18 UN-rated steel drums before shipment, and a hazardous-waste manifest is required. The classification is not yet in the formal waste register because I've been waiting for your disposition signature, Mara.
